reviewer: Coordinating agent against frozen D03 input; not independent user research
scope: Proposed recovery contract, not working scheduler/solver implementation
observations: Retains existing Slurm/Apptainer; requeue invokes explicit compatible checkpoint restart rather than assuming process continuation.
120 seconds notice minus supplied 70+20 seconds leaves 30 seconds for other overhead; overhead/real scale remain unverified and no RTO is invented.
Attempt/run identity, complete checkpoints, output watermark and fenced/no-replace publication address partial writes, duplicate attempts and lost acknowledgements.
Failure schedule separates node loss, warning, checkpoint, publication, queue/restart and quota; GPU/MPI/driver/fabric compatibility requires actual multi-node evidence.
limitations: Artifact is a detailed plan. No Slurm wrapper, solver integration, filesystem atomicity, runtime checkpoint, failover, performance or recovery measurement is demonstrated. Held-out output was not used to tune instructions.
